newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Kocbank gets $75 mln, 1-yr syndication loan.
newsitem.headline: Turk Kocbank gets $75 mln, 1-yr syndication loan.

text.p: Turkey's Kocbank, a medium-sized private bank belonging to the Koc industrial conglomerate said it secured a $75 million, one-year syndication loan to be used in export finance.

An agreement for the loan facility was signed on April 23 by lead managers The Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd, Credit Lyonnais, The Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and Nations Bank Capital Markets International Ltd, Kocbank said.
It also said the syndication bore the lowest interest cost among loan facilities secured by Turkish banks from international markets so far this year, but did not give details.
